points.source_span: عند باب الديوانية النعال تتكوم وريحتها مو حلوة

points.statement: A box that holds slippers and sterilizes them with UV light.
points.source_span: صندوق تحط فيه النعال ويطلع فيه ضوء UV يعقمها

points.statement: A timer turns the light off automatically after a quarter of an hour.
points.source_span: وفيه timer يطفي الضوء بروحه بعد ربع ساعة

points.statement: The light must not operate while the lid is open.
points.source_span: ولازم الضوء ما يشتغل إذا الغطا مفتوح

points.statement: Keeps pairs of socks together in the washing machine so they come out matched.
points.source_span: Something to keep pairs of socks together in the washing machine so they come out still matched

points.statement: For example, a small ring that both socks are threaded through.
points.source_span: Like a small ring you thread both socks through

points.statement: It must not be magnetic.
points.source_span: Not magnetic

points.statement: It must not be made of plastic.
points.source_span: not made of plastic

must_not_add: A specific material such as metal or silicone

points.statement: A hallway mat that plays a soft chime in the user's bedroom when someone steps on it.
points.source_span: a mat for the hallway that plays a soft chime in my bedroom when someone steps on it

points.statement: It is active only between midnight and 6 a.m.
points.source_span: But only between midnight and six in the morning

points.statement: It stays silent the rest of the day.
points.source_span: the rest of the day it should stay quiet

points.statement: A shower head that stops the water automatically unless someone is standing under it.
points.source_span: A shower head that stops the water by itself unless someone is actually standing under it

points.statement: Example: stepping out of the stream to shampoo.
points.source_span: like when you step out to shampoo your hair

points.statement: When the person steps back in, the water returns immediately at the same temperature.
points.source_span: As soon as you step back in, the water comes back at the same temperature

points.statement: The user's existing copper coffee dallah is not part of the invention.
points.source_span: عندي دلّة قهوة نحاسية

points.statement: A padded cover that fits onto the dallah itself and keeps it hot.
points.source_span: أريد غطاءً مبطناً يُلبَس على الدلة نفسها ويحافظ على حرارتها

points.statement: It has one opening for the handle and one for the spout, so coffee can be poured without removing it.
points.source_span: مع فتحة للمقبض وأخرى للفوهة حتى أصبّ دون أن أنزعه

points.statement: A sunshade that opens over the windshield automatically as soon as the car is parked.
points.source_span: مظلة تنفتح بروحها على الجامة أول ما أوقف السيارة

points.statement: It closes when the driver wants to leave.
points.source_span: وتتسكر يوم أبي أمشي

points.statement: The power source is unknown: the car battery or something else.
points.source_span: بس والله ما أدري شنو اللي بيشغلها، بطارية السيارة ولا شي ثاني

points.statement: A coffee thermos for desert outings (kashta).
points.source_span: ترمس قهوة للكشتة

points.statement: It must keep the coffee hot for at least eight hours; this is a firm condition.
points.source_span: لازم يحافظ على حرارة القهوة ثمان ساعات على الأقل، هذا شرط

points.statement: It must have a spout that does not drip.
points.source_span: ولازم يكون له مصب ما ينقط

points.statement: A gold colour would be nice but is not required.
points.source_span: ويا ليت لو لونه ذهبي يطلع حلو بالبر، بس مو ضروري

points.statement: A prayer mat that counts rak'as automatically so elderly people don't lose count.
points.source_span: سجادة صلاة تعدّ الركعات تلقائياً حتى لا ينسى كبار السن كم صلّوا

points.statement: Each time the worshipper prostrates, the mat adds one rak'a to the count.
points.source_span: عندما يسجد المصلي تضيف السجادة ركعة إلى العدد

points.statement: The count is shown on a small screen at the mat's edge.
points.source_span: ويظهر الرقم على شاشة صغيرة في طرفها

must_not_add: Correcting the logic to two prostrations per rak'a
Sound alerts or a phone app

points.statement: The ceiling fan turns on by itself only when room temperature exceeds 30 degrees.
points.source_span: مروحة سقف تشتغل وحدها فقط إذا تجاوزت حرارة الغرفة ثلاثين درجة

points.statement: It stops when the temperature drops.
points.source_span: وتتوقف عندما تنخفض الحرارة

points.statement: If someone turned it on manually, it does not turn itself off.
points.source_span: لكن إذا كان أحد قد شغّلها يدوياً فلا تطفئ نفسها

points.statement: A suitcase that converts into a seat for long waits at the airport.
points.source_span: حقيبة سفر تتحول إلى مقعد عند الانتظار الطويل في المطار

points.statement: It must support a person weighing up to 100 kg.
points.source_span: يجب أن تتحمل وزن شخص حتى مئة كيلوغرام

points.statement: It must stay within the permitted carry-on size.
points.source_span: ويجب أن تبقى ضمن مقاس حقيبة اليد المسموح به في الطائرة

points.statement: It should preferably be lightweight.
points.source_span: أفضّل أن تكون خفيفة

points.statement: A small backrest would be nice.
points.source_span: وسيكون جميلاً لو كان لها مسند صغير للظهر

points.statement: A small clip attached to the fishing line near the rod.
points.source_span: a little clip that goes on the fishing line near the rod

points.statement: When a fish bites and pulls the line, it sends a vibration to a wristband.
points.source_span: When a fish bites and pulls the line, it sends a buzz to a band you wear on your wrist

points.statement: It makes no noise, because noise scares fish.
points.source_span: It wouldn't make any noise, because noise scares the fish

points.statement: The kitchen hood turns on by itself only when it senses smoke or a burning smell.
points.source_span: شفاط للمطبخ يشتغل لوحده بس لما يحس إن فيه دخان أو ريحة شياط

points.statement: It keeps running until the air is clear.
points.source_span: ويفضل شغال لحد ما الجو ينضف

points.statement: If someone presses the button, it turns off immediately even when there is smoke.
points.source_span: ولو حد داس على الزرار يقفل علطول حتى لو فيه دخان

points.statement: A small dining table that folds and hangs behind the door after meals.
points.source_span: ترابيزة سفرة صغيرة تتطبق وتتعلق ورا الباب لما نخلص أكل

points.statement: The apartment is small (the reason).
points.source_span: عشان الشقة ضيقة

points.statement: No iron hinges at all.
points.source_span: من غير مفصلات حديد خالص

points.statement: Its legs must not scratch the floor tiles.
points.source_span: ومش عايز رجليها تخربش البلاط

must_not_add: A ban on all hinges (only iron hinges are excluded)

points.statement: A handle that clips onto several plastic grocery bags at once so they don't cut into the fingers.
points.source_span: A handle you clip onto several plastic grocery bags at once so they don't cut into your fingers

points.statement: It must fold small enough to fit in a coat pocket.
points.source_span: It absolutely must fold small enough to live in a coat pocket

points.statement: Metal is preferred over plastic, if possible.
points.source_span: I'd rather it was metal than plastic if possible

points.statement: A jar for cooling drinking water.
points.source_span: أريد جرة لتبريد ماء الشرب

points.statement: It works without electricity and without ice.
points.source_span: تعمل من دون كهرباء ومن دون ثلج

points.statement: Like the traditional clay jars, but colder.
points.source_span: مثل الجرار الفخارية القديمة لكن أبرد

points.statement: Water must not leak onto the floor.
points.source_span: ولا أريد أن يتسرب منها الماء على الأرض

must_not_add: That it must be made of clay
A specific cooling mechanism as decided

points.statement: The existing kitchen gas cylinder is not part of the invention.
points.source_span: بطل الغاز مال المطبخ

points.statement: A base the gas cylinder sits on that weighs it.
points.source_span: فكرت بقاعدة نحط عليها البطل توزنه

points.statement: It whistles when the gas is nearly empty.
points.source_span: وإذا قرّب يخلص تصفر

points.statement: It does not whistle at night, so the children aren't woken.
points.source_span: بس ما تصفر بالليل عشان لا تقعّد اليهال

points.statement: The existing rooftop solar panels are the setting.
points.source_span: الألواح الشمسية فوق سطح بيتي

points.statement: A brush that moves across the panels by itself and wipes them weekly.
points.source_span: أريد فرشاة تمشي على الألواح وحدها وتمسحها كل أسبوع

points.statement: What will drive the brush is unknown: a motor or something else.
points.source_span: لا أعرف حتى الآن ما الذي سيحرّك الفرشاة، هل محرك أم شيء آخر

points.statement: Whether it uses water is undecided.
points.source_span: ولم أقرر هل تستخدم الماء أم لا

points.statement: A device that peels a whole head of garlic at once.
points.source_span: حاجة تقشر التوم كله مرة واحدة

points.statement: Cloves go in; the peels and the peeled garlic come out separately.
points.source_span: تحطي الفصوص فيها وتطلعي القشر لوحده والتوم لوحده

points.statement: Whether it is electric or hand-shaken is unknown.
points.source_span: بس بصراحة مش عارفة هتشتغل بإيه، بالكهربا ولا بالهز باليد

points.statement: A rolling pin with rings that slide onto both ends so the dough always comes out the same thickness.
points.source_span: A rolling pin with rings you slide onto both ends so the dough always comes out the same thickness

points.statement: Different rings give thin or thick dough.
points.source_span: Different rings for thin and thick

points.statement: The rings must be easy to swap without tools.
points.source_span: The rings should be easy to swap without tools

must_not_add: Praise such as 'best invention ever' (embedded instruction, not part of the idea)

points.statement: A mosquito net that spreads around the bed by itself at night and gathers up in the morning with no effort.
points.source_span: ناموسية تتفرد حوالين السرير لوحدها بالليل وتتلم الصبح من غير ما حد يتعب نفسه

points.statement: Possibly driven by a small motor, or by a rope and pulley; not yet sure.
points.source_span: يمكن بموتور صغير، أو يمكن بحبل وبكرة، لسه مش متأكد

must_not_add: A phone app or specific times

points.statement: Gloves for outdoor winter workers that warn when the fingers are getting dangerously cold.
points.source_span: gloves for people who work outside in winter that warn you when your fingers are getting dangerously cold

points.statement: The warning might be a vibration on the wrist.
points.source_span: Maybe a buzz on the wrist or something

points.statement: How the glove would detect cold fingers is unknown.
points.source_span: I have no idea how the glove would actually know your fingers are cold though

points.statement: A wheeled shopping trolley for the market.
points.source_span: عربية شنط للسوق بعجل

points.statement: It must be able to climb stairs, since there is no lift.
points.source_span: لازم تعرف تطلع السلم لأن مفيش أسانسير عندنا

points.statement: It must carry at least 20 kg.
points.source_span: ولازم تشيل عشرين كيلو على الأقل

points.statement: A dark colour would be nice, so dirt doesn't show.
points.source_span: ويا ريت تكون لونها غامق عشان متبانش وسخة

points.statement: Preferably foldable.
points.source_span: وأحسن لو تتطبق

points.statement: A back cushion placed on a chair that warms and gives a light massage.
points.source_span: مخدة للظهر تحطها على الكرسي وتدفي وتسوي مساج خفيف

points.statement: It might run on a rechargeable battery.
points.source_span: يمكن تشتغل ببطارية تنشحن

points.statement: Probably 20 minutes of massage is enough, then it stops.
points.source_span: وأظن عشرين دقيقة مساج تكفي وبعدين توقف

must_not_add: The battery or 20-minute time as fixed

points.statement: A pasta cutter rolled over the dough that cuts several equal-width strips at once.
points.source_span: A pasta cutter you roll over the rolled-out dough and it cuts several strips at once, all the same width

points.statement: No electricity or batteries; hand-pushed only.
points.source_span: No electricity, no batteries, just your hand pushing it

points.statement: No parts that must be taken apart for cleaning.
points.source_span: And I don't want any parts that need to be taken apart to clean

points.statement: A home incense burner that works without charcoal.
points.source_span: أبي مبخرة للبيت بدون فحم

points.statement: It must not produce much smoke; a little is enough.
points.source_span: ولا أبيها تطلع دخان وايد يخنق الصالة، شوي بس يكفي

points.statement: A boot dryer that wet boots slide onto after walking in snow.
points.source_span: a boot dryer that you slide wet boots onto after walking in snow

points.statement: It blows warm air down into the toes so the boots are dry by morning.
points.source_span: It blows warm air right down into the toes so they are dry by morning

points.statement: It switches itself off after two hours.
points.source_span: It should switch itself off after two hours

points.statement: A tea strainer in the cup that lowers the leaves into the water and then rises by itself after a chosen time.
points.source_span: مصفاة شاي تضعها في الكوب فتنزل الأوراق في الماء ثم ترتفع وحدها بعد الوقت الذي تختاره

points.statement: Its purpose is to stop the tea becoming bitter.
points.source_span: حتى لا يصبح الشاي مرّاً

points.statement: It might work with a spring, like an old wind-up timer.
points.source_span: ربما تعمل بزنبرك مثل المؤقت القديم

points.statement: Three minutes is probably enough as the maximum time.
points.source_span: وأظن أن ثلاث دقائق تكفي كأقصى وقت

must_not_add: Three minutes as a fixed brew time

points.statement: A folding step stool for the kitchen.
points.source_span: a folding step stool for the kitchen

points.statement: It must hold at least 120 kg.
points.source_span: can hold at least 120 kilos, that part is a must

points.statement: It must fold flat enough to fit between the fridge and the wall.
points.source_span: It has to fold flat enough to fit between the fridge and the wall

points.statement: Light blue would be nice but is not important.
points.source_span: It would be nice if it came in a light blue, but that's not a big deal

points.statement: A cutting board with a built-in scale, so vegetables can be weighed while being chopped.
points.source_span: a cutting board with a scale built into it, so you can weigh vegetables while you chop them

points.statement: When food is placed on it, the weight appears on a small screen in the corner.
points.source_span: When you put food on it, the weight shows on a little screen in the corner

points.statement: A single button resets it to zero.
points.source_span: You press one button to reset it to zero

points.statement: The user's existing heavy old sewing machine is not part of the invention.
points.source_span: I have an old sewing machine that weighs a ton

points.statement: A small wheeled base the machine straps onto, so it can be rolled to the table and back.
points.source_span: a little wheeled base that it straps onto, so I can roll it out to the table and back

points.statement: The base locks its wheels so it doesn't slide during sewing.
points.source_span: The base should lock its wheels so it doesn't slide while I sew
